Formula Sheet

The definitions, axioms and theorems of probability from Part II. Each one links to the place in the book where it is stated (and, for the theorems, proved).

Definitions

Mutually exclusive. Two propositions φ\varphiφ and ψ\psiψ are mutually exclusive iff there is no row of their truth-table in which both are true. (So φ∧ψ\varphi \land \psiφ∧ψ is a contradiction, and P⁡(φ∧ψ)=0\Prb(\varphi \land \psi) = 0P(φ∧ψ)=0.) (Definition 4.1)

Conditional probability. For any φ\varphiφ and ψ\psiψ, if P⁡(ψ)≠0\Prb(\psi) \neq 0P(ψ)=0, then P⁡(φ∣ψ)=P⁡(φ∧ψ)/P⁡(ψ)\Prb(\varphi \given \psi) = \Prb(\varphi \land \psi) / \Prb(\psi)P(φ∣ψ)=P(φ∧ψ)/P(ψ). (Definition 4.2)

Independence. φ\varphiφ is independent of ψ\psiψ iff P⁡(ψ)≠0\Prb(\psi) \neq 0P(ψ)=0 and P⁡(φ∣ψ)=P⁡(φ)\Prb(\varphi \given \psi) = \Prb(\varphi)P(φ∣ψ)=P(φ). φ\varphiφ is dependent on ψ\psiψ iff P⁡(ψ)≠0\Prb(\psi) \neq 0P(ψ)=0 and P⁡(φ∣ψ)≠P⁡(φ)\Prb(\varphi \given \psi) \neq \Prb(\varphi)P(φ∣ψ)=P(φ). φ\varphiφ and ψ\psiψ are independent of each other iff each is independent of the other. (Definition 5.2)

Conditional independence. φ\varphiφ and χ\chiχ are independent conditional on ψ\psiψ iff P⁡(φ∧χ∣ψ)=P⁡(φ∣ψ)×P⁡(χ∣ψ)\Prb(\varphi \land \chi \given \psi) = \Prb(\varphi \given \psi) \times \Prb(\chi \given \psi)P(φ∧χ∣ψ)=P(φ∣ψ)×P(χ∣ψ). (Chapter 6)

Axioms

Non-negativity. For any φ\varphiφ, P⁡(φ)≥0\Prb(\varphi) \geq 0P(φ)≥0. (Axiom 1)

Normality. If τ\tauτ is a tautology, then P⁡(τ)=1\Prb(\tau) = 1P(τ)=1. (Axiom 2)

Additivity. If φ\varphiφ and ψ\psiψ are mutually exclusive, then P⁡(φ∨ψ)=P⁡(φ)+P⁡(ψ)\Prb(\varphi \lor \psi) = \Prb(\varphi) + \Prb(\psi)P(φ∨ψ)=P(φ)+P(ψ). (Axiom 3)

Theorems

Contradiction. If φ\varphiφ is a contradiction, then P⁡(φ)=0\Prb(\varphi) = 0P(φ)=0. (Theorem 5.1)

Complement. For any φ\varphiφ, P⁡(φ)+P⁡(¬φ)=1\Prb(\varphi) + \Prb(\neg\varphi) = 1P(φ)+P(¬φ)=1. (Theorem 5.5)

Equivalence. If φ\varphiφ and ψ\psiψ are tautologically equivalent, then P⁡(φ)=P⁡(ψ)\Prb(\varphi) = \Prb(\psi)P(φ)=P(ψ). (Theorem 5.6)

Bounds. For any φ\varphiφ, 0≤P⁡(φ)≤10 \leq \Prb(\varphi) \leq 10≤P(φ)≤1. (Theorem 5.7)

Entailment. If φ⊨ψ\varphi \vDash \psiφ⊨ψ, then P⁡(φ)≤P⁡(ψ)\Prb(\varphi) \leq \Prb(\psi)P(φ)≤P(ψ). (Theorem 5.8)

Extended additivity. If φ1,…,φn\varphi_{1}, \ldots, \varphi_{n}φ1​,…,φn​ are pairwise mutually exclusive, then P⁡(φ1∨⋯∨φn)=P⁡(φ1)+⋯+P⁡(φn)\Prb(\varphi_{1} \lor \cdots \lor \varphi_{n}) = \Prb(\varphi_{1}) + \cdots + \Prb(\varphi_{n})P(φ1​∨⋯∨φn​)=P(φ1​)+⋯+P(φn​). (Theorem 5.9)

Inclusion-exclusion. For any φ\varphiφ and ψ\psiψ, P⁡(φ∨ψ)=P⁡(φ)+P⁡(ψ)−P⁡(φ∧ψ)\Prb(\varphi \lor \psi) = \Prb(\varphi) + \Prb(\psi) - \Prb(\varphi \land \psi)P(φ∨ψ)=P(φ)+P(ψ)−P(φ∧ψ). (Theorem 5.10)

Conjunction. For any φ\varphiφ and ψ\psiψ: (a) if P⁡(ψ)≠0\Prb(\psi) \neq 0P(ψ)=0, then P⁡(φ∧ψ)=P⁡(φ∣ψ)×P⁡(ψ)\Prb(\varphi \land \psi) = \Prb(\varphi \given \psi) \times \Prb(\psi)P(φ∧ψ)=P(φ∣ψ)×P(ψ); (b) if P⁡(ψ)=0\Prb(\psi) = 0P(ψ)=0, then P⁡(φ∧ψ)=0\Prb(\varphi \land \psi) = 0P(φ∧ψ)=0. (Theorem 5.11)

Conjunction of independents. If φ\varphiφ is independent of ψ\psiψ, then P⁡(φ∧ψ)=P⁡(φ)×P⁡(ψ)\Prb(\varphi \land \psi) = \Prb(\varphi) \times \Prb(\psi)P(φ∧ψ)=P(φ)×P(ψ). (Theorem 5.12)

Product test. If P⁡(ψ)≠0\Prb(\psi) \neq 0P(ψ)=0, then φ\varphiφ is independent of ψ\psiψ iff P⁡(φ∧ψ)=P⁡(φ)×P⁡(ψ)\Prb(\varphi \land \psi) = \Prb(\varphi) \times \Prb(\psi)P(φ∧ψ)=P(φ)×P(ψ). (†)

Symmetry of independence. If P⁡(φ)≠0\Prb(\varphi) \neq 0P(φ)=0 and P⁡(ψ)≠0\Prb(\psi) \neq 0P(ψ)=0, then φ\varphiφ is independent of ψ\psiψ iff ψ\psiψ is independent of φ\varphiφ. (Theorem 5.13)

Conditional complement. If P⁡(ψ)≠0\Prb(\psi) \neq 0P(ψ)=0, then P⁡(φ∣ψ)+P⁡(¬φ∣ψ)=1\Prb(\varphi \given \psi) + \Prb(\neg\varphi \given \psi) = 1P(φ∣ψ)+P(¬φ∣ψ)=1. (Theorem 5.14)

Bayes' theorem. If P⁡(φ)≠0\Prb(\varphi) \neq 0P(φ)=0 and P⁡(ψ)≠0\Prb(\psi) \neq 0P(ψ)=0, then P⁡(φ∣ψ)=P⁡(ψ∣φ)×P⁡(φ)/P⁡(ψ)\Prb(\varphi \given \psi) = \Prb(\psi \given \varphi) \times \Prb(\varphi) / \Prb(\psi)P(φ∣ψ)=P(ψ∣φ)×P(φ)/P(ψ). (Theorem 6.3)

Total probability. If 0<P⁡(ψ)<10 < \Prb(\psi) < 10<P(ψ)<1, then P⁡(φ)=P⁡(φ∣ψ)×P⁡(ψ)+P⁡(φ∣¬ψ)×P⁡(¬ψ)\Prb(\varphi) = \Prb(\varphi \given \psi) \times \Prb(\psi) + \Prb(\varphi \given \neg\psi) \times \Prb(\neg\psi)P(φ)=P(φ∣ψ)×P(ψ)+P(φ∣¬ψ)×P(¬ψ). (Theorem 6.4)

Bayes' theorem (LTP). If 0<P⁡(φ)<10 < \Prb(\varphi) < 10<P(φ)<1 and P⁡(ψ)≠0\Prb(\psi) \neq 0P(ψ)=0, then P⁡(φ∣ψ)=P⁡(ψ∣φ)×P⁡(φ)P⁡(ψ∣φ)×P⁡(φ)+P⁡(ψ∣¬φ)×P⁡(¬φ).\Prb(\varphi \given \psi) = \frac{\Prb(\psi \given \varphi) \times \Prb(\varphi)}{\Prb(\psi \given \varphi) \times \Prb(\varphi) + \Prb(\psi \given \neg\varphi) \times \Prb(\neg\varphi)}.P(φ∣ψ)=P(ψ∣φ)×P(φ)+P(ψ∣¬φ)×P(¬φ)P(ψ∣φ)×P(φ)​. (Theorem 6.5)

† Not proved in the text; it follows quickly from the definitions and theorems above.
